description:
Send sBTC to the pool and receive voting weight proportional to your share of the contributed balance.

SPENDS REAL sBTC AND IS NOT REFUNDABLE — you get a say in which pieces get paid, not a claim on the pool. There is no withdrawal function. To fund the pool without a vote, use legion_sponsor.

Metered against the wallet's `sats` spending limit before signing, so a large contribution blocks until you raise SPEND_LIMIT_SESSION_SATS.

Crossing the minimum weight also makes you a MEMBER, which is what unlocks proposals for the whole legion once enough members join.

Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

sats.description: Amount of sBTC to contribute, in sats
